description: Annual Growth in Peak Electricity Demand by Sector (%) is a data set listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by KAHRAMAA. This dataset provides annual growth rates in peak electricity demand across different sectors in Qatar, including system-wide, industrial, and domestic. The values reflect the percentage increase in maximum load compared to the previous year. This information supports energy demand forecasting, infrastructure planning, and sectoral performance evaluation. Coverage: Qatar. The portal files it under the publisher KAHRAMAA. Its tags are electricity, growth, demand, peak, system. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-06-20 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
